canonical_definition.name: Sequential Pruning Operator
canonical_definition.reading: Given a candidate continuation set C_t produced under delta_a, S removes candidates that fail sequential admissibility constraints before Arb_A selects a realized continuation.

formal_candidate.candidate_set: C_t := {q_i | q_i is admissible under initial delta_a constraints}
formal_candidate.pruned_set: C_t^S := {q_i in C_t | S_R,A(q_i, chi_D, R_<->, A_adm) = PASS}
formal_candidate.failure_condition: C_t^S = emptyset -> admissibility branch collapse or re-orientation trigger review

pipeline_position: delta_a generates candidate continuation set C_t
negative_constraints: S does not select the realized continuation.
S does not promote topology, geometry, or physics-app claims.
S must not depend on post-realization outcomes.
